assumptions: cost is linear in build keys
no memory-pressure cost: the production retain loop holds every archive, modelled at about 19 GB footprint for 30 keys (wci_retain_stream_memory_v1); this canary does not reach it
projection.basis: least-squares line through the three measured _raw_index_records wall times against build keys, evaluated at 30 keys, plus the mean _bound_inputs time
projection.scope: _bound_inputs plus _raw_index_records only; oracle comparison, index write/load and the indexed ledger are not in it
